notes.title: Update Announcement on October 19th
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your support. Based on your feedback, we have made some optimizations to the game

The content of this update is as follows:
1. Fixed the issue of some players getting stuck between chapters 3-4 and those getting stuck after entering investment quotas. In the event of an error, it will not cause players to get stuck, and a skip button will automatically pop up
2. Optimized the investment mechanism of Mr. Jia in Chapter 3 and lowered the minimum investment amount
3. Modified the text of the betting agreement options
4. Revised the final floating screen text in Chapter 5
5. Replaced the 2K resources of the Season 6 Poetry Language Line in Chapter 6
6. Modified the dubbing and text of some videos in Chapter 6
7. Fixed the display error of sunglasses props in Chapter 2

Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/11609bb8ec98e56bef2f56e7a7eaa4733d6a6233.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcement on fixing and compensating for bugs during server launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, bosses!

Firstly, thank you all for your attention and support. Due to the technician secretly signing a female anchor to play while fixing a bug, bringing their own files into the update package, some players who entered the game before 11:37 had their saved files overwritten. The known issue has been resolved, and the person who caused the problem has had a set of signed photos confiscated. The production team once again extends sincere apologies to the affected players. [u] [b] Any affected players can join the official QQ group with their purchase records before 11:37 to contact the official and receive a copy of the "Actor&Guest Appearance Complete Set Seal" peripheral [/b] [/u].

(Official QQ Group 2 826706420)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/7e51d91a826651cd7cbbc46d8c7669539cb25304.png[/img]

In addition, since the server was launched nearly 5 hours ago, we have received enthusiastic feedback from many players about some bugs in the game and have completed urgent fixes.

The game has been updated and the fixed bugs are:
1. Solved the problem of fragmented graphics in some games
2. Fixed the bug where 2K resource packs cause black screens
3. Solved the bug in the first chapter where some of the images were not synchronized in terms of sound and image
4. Fixed the bug of abnormal cloud archiving

Thank you for your understanding and support. Wishing you both a fruitful love and career. Have a great game!

[h2]【游戏简介】 [/h2]
《开局五个亿》是一款超现实模拟经营类互动影像游戏，你将以主角的身份，完成启动资金五个亿的创业历程。在这场围绕金钱和爱情展开的冒险中，六位怀着各自目的，身份、类型各异的美女将参与到你的事业之中，当感情和事业相互交织，你将如何平衡与她们之间的关系？忙于创业的你又将如何选择？ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/1945e9008c7cc2915a410676cf621702e8b2c659.png[/img]

[h2]【游戏特色】 [/h2]

[h3]■ 真实创业体验，“事业”“爱情”双主线 [/h3]
根据玩家投资决策，形成不同的财富收益，进而影响女主的感情结局。更真实体验游戏中“事业”与“爱情”双主线相互交织的关系，不同于其他男频恋爱类互动影游，本游戏更注重模拟经营创业的真实过程，大量呈现了爱情和事业的两难选择，更贴近现实生活。 
[h3]■ “事业”亦是“爱情”，第一人称超现实互动恋爱体验 [/h3]
游戏过程中随着主角财富值和事业的变化对应逐步揭示了演员不同阶段对角色内心世界的心路刻画。不同阶段下女主态度和对男主诉求的变化将影响玩家恋爱体验。 
[h3]■ 超一线网红&实力派演员携手，高质量创业心跳大冒险 [/h3]
温心，梅宝莱，陈思澈，李心爱，刘梦茹等实力派演员主演，花碎花，DJ江小白，牛奶公主小章，是你依然，詹妮Jenny，刘一琳，小玥玥，板板酱，Swan，车模土豆丝等知名网红主播参演。 
在游戏中她们将扮演或妩媚、或柔情、或无邪、或任性，亦或性感火热，高贵冷艳，性格迥异的美女，陪伴你的创业之路。 
[h3]■ 百余种故事分支，多条隐藏故事暗线与彩蛋 [/h3]
产品为您设计了百余种故事分支，多条隐藏故事暗线与彩蛋。“财富”和“情商”同样重要，在游戏中收集各种成就、挖掘她们的秘密，做出最符合本心的选择，而不是最可能是正确的选择将为你带来意想不到的收获。 

PS：本游戏在剧情中穿插了超过100余个映射原型事件的“梗”，不仅有“娱乐梗”和“事件梗”更有部分“专业梗”期待玩家们自行挖掘~
